design_signals.text: For summer swing dresses, heavy fabric can weigh down your silhouette. That’s why we selected the airy cotton-rayon blend, light as a feather, soft as a cloud. The subtle "bubbles" created by special weaving not only bring the print to life but also add a gentle stretch. Plus, the fabrics get even softer and gain a subtle thickness with washing, though lightly puckered which smooth out after a quick steam ironing.|||The beauty of mature women never needs to try too hard. You see it in the loose sway of a relaxed hem, in a variety of prints that shift with your mood. Most patterns in black or blue background, calm and modest. Then come the lively green, light pink, and royal purple. And when the occasion calls for something more formal, there are solid black and dark cyan, elegant and confident.|||Empire waist dresses flow into a swinging skirt. Like a gentle embrace, they gracefully flatter plus size figures and offer ease for maternity wear. Below the hips, the skirt’s tier features slightly curved seams that naturally contour to the body, softly shaping the hips for a feminine silhouette. And after six rounds of refinement, the short sleeves are cut to end just above the waist, shifting the focus upward and keeping the look light and fluid.|||The V-neck really is the sweet spot, just open enough to feel fresh and flattering, yet never too revealing. Add a necklace that follows the neckline, instantly the look turns delicate but still effortless. Since style and convenience both matter, these boho maxi dresses also feature two hidden side-seam pockets which don't add bulk.|||Garment Care: Hand wash in cold water. Line dry. Low ironing if necessary.
